title: Parsing a complete encoded field
statement: For any Boolean input word $x$, valid input-head position $p$, Boolean lists $u,w,r,o$ with $|o| \le |w|$, start the reader in its initial scanning control with stream $u ++ \langle w,r\rangle$, target $o$, stream head at $|u|$, and target head at zero. After $3|w|+3$ steps it is in the completed control, with target $w$, stream head at $|u|+2|w|+2$, target head at zero, and the stream unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean input word and valid input-head position
arbitrary stream prefix, field word, stream tail, and old target
old target length at most field length
replaced: For every input word, input position, stream prefix $u$, field word $w$, stream tail, and old target of length at most $|w|$, running the reader for $3|w| + 3$ steps from the scanning control at stream cursor $|u|$ yields the completed control, in which exactly one encoded field is consumed, the target is $w$ with its head restored to zero, the whole stream is preserved, and the stream cursor sits just past the consumed field; the empty field takes three steps.
